items.title: STAT+: What’s the deal with Isomorphic Labs?
items.summary: In this edition of STAT's AI Prognosis: What does Isomorphic Labs' high valuation say about AI's role in drug development, and the debate around AI and cost of care.

items.title: GSK, Ionis win US approval for first-of-its-kind hepatitis B drug
items.summary: Hibsago is viewed as a potential “functional cure” for chronic infections and an important part of the British drugmaker’s goal of reaching £40 billion in annual revenue by 2031.

items.title: Arcus kidney cancer data impresses analysts; TriGemX inks a SPAC deal
items.summary: New follow-up results suggest Arcus’ drug might be superior to a marketed Merck medicine. Elsewhere, Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca forged new partnerships.

items.title: STAT+: He’s slashing quality at nursing homes. This state is letting it happen
items.summary: The Boston Globe Spotlight Team found Eli Mirlis made grim cuts to resident care while steering millions of dollars from his nursing homes’ revenue into a constellation of real estate

items.title: STAT+: Roche continues to look to China for new drugs
items.summary: China's Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group has announced that it struck a massive deal with Roche to develop a portfolio of antibody-drug conjugates.

items.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about drug launch prices, an AstraZeneca AI deal, and more
items.summary: The median net price for newly launched medicines, when adjusted for inflation and manufacturer discounts, rose by 35% from 2022 to 2025.

items.title: Rapport’s epilepsy drug finds surprising success in bipolar trial
items.summary: Despite what some analysts described as low expectations, RAP-219 narrowly hit the main goal of a mid-stage study, results that could help it tap a billion-dollar-plus market opportunity.

items.title: Hype vs. reality: What pharma’s hottest R&D bets have actually proved
items.summary: New types of bispecifics, antibody-drug conjugates and cell therapies haven’t yet proven themselves in the clinic. Pharmaceutical companies are betting billions anyway.

items.title: Merck KGaA bets on RNAi with $1.3B Silence buyout
items.summary: The acquisition gives the German company a promising blood disorder medicine that passed a 第二期試驗 test and could threaten a Takeda drug.

items.title: Roche inks $15B ADC pact with Hansoh; Veradermics scores in another baldness study
items.summary: Roche is paying Hansoh $400 million up front in a broad deal involving several ADCs. Elsewhere, another top investor formed a China-focused fund and Ultragenyx sold a second review voucher.
